sentence: This project studies how changes in perineuronal nets in a part of the hippocampus affect social memory problems in Alzheimer's disease.
This project studies how small molecules called metabolites help coordinate the development of the vertebrate embryo.
This project studies how the fusion protein that causes Ewing sarcoma works, using genomics, biophysical, and single molecule approaches.
This project provides tests that measure immune cells and their responses to cancer immunotherapies, using mass cytometry and tissue imaging.
This project studies how epigenetic regulation of immunometabolism helps the malaria mosquito Anopheles stephensi defend against Plasmodium.
This project provides high-throughput sequencing and bioinformatic analysis to find changes in transcription, splicing, and chromatin that drive cancer growth.
This project tries to find out why measles virus spreads from one host to another so easily.
This project studies how an architectural protein helps cells fix DNA damage through nucleotide excision repair inside the nucleus.
This project builds a protein contrast agent for MRI that targets collagen to image lung fibrosis.
This project studies what factors affect cancer risk and outcomes, and builds behavioral interventions to improve outcomes for people with cancer.
This project studies how faulty autophagy leads B lymphocytes to make autoantibodies against RNA and DNA in the autoimmune disease Systemic Lupus Erythematosus.
This project builds automation technologies that speed up the continuous evolution of proteins in the laboratory for use as therapies.
This project studies how human papillomavirus infects skin cells and how infected cells keep the viral genomes.
This project tests the safety of a DNA vaccine for treating human papillomavirus type 16 cancer precursor lesions in women with and without HIV.
This project develops a gene editing treatment, delivered by lipid nanoparticles into the front of the eye, to lower intraocular pressure in glaucoma.
This project tries to understand the processes involved in lupus nephritis and to find reliable biomarkers.
This project studies the molecular mechanisms that cause human cancers to arise and progress.
This project studies how a protein controls the behavior of tumor stem cells in glioblastoma, a brain cancer, by modifying a transcription factor.
This project builds gene-editing tools to control Aedes aegypti mosquito populations that spread dengue.
